hrm:d4e1e5435c3ad466.question: Đếm số nhân viên theo từng phòng ban
hrm:d4e1e5435c3ad466.sql:
SELECT d.department_id, d.department_name, COUNT(e.employee_id) as count
    FROM department d
    LEFT JOIN employee e ON d.department_id = e.department_id
    GROUP BY d.department_id, d.department_name
    ORDER BY count DESC
    LIMIT 100;

hrm:bfd501d0e45f840c.question: Xem lịch sử chấm công của nhân viên EMP020 từ 01/03/2026 đến 15/03/2026
hrm:bfd501d0e45f840c.sql:
SELECT
    a.attendance_id,
    a.employee_id,
    e.employee_name,
    a.attendance_date,
    a.check_in_time,
    a.check_out_time,
    a.status
FROM attendance a
JOIN employee e ON a.employee_id = e.employee_id
WHERE e.employee_id = 'EMP020'
    AND a.attendance_date BETWEEN '2026-03-01' AND '2026-03-15'
ORDER BY a.attendance_date DESC
LIMIT 100;

hrm:e05c187ce3e5a8fe.question: Liệt kê đơn nghỉ phép đã được duyệt trong tháng 3
hrm:e05c187ce3e5a8fe.sql:
SELECT lr.request_id, lr.employee_id, lr.start_date, lr.end_date, lr.total_days, lr.reason, lr.status
FROM leave_request lr
WHERE lr.start_date >= CURRENT_DATE
ORDER BY lr.total_days DESC
LIMIT 100;

hrm:966672dfab80e78c.question: Tra cứu đơn xin nghỉ của nhân viên EMP012 năm 2026
hrm:966672dfab80e78c.sql:
SELECT lr.request_id, lr.employee_id, e.employee_name, lt.leave_type_name, lr.start_date, lr.end_date, lr.total_days, lr.reason, lr.status, lr.created_at
FROM leave_request lr
JOIN employee e ON lr.employee_id = e.employee_id
JOIN leave_type lt ON lr.leave_type_id = lt.leave_type_id
WHERE lr.employee_id = 'EMP012'
ORDER BY lr.created_at DESC
LIMIT 100;

hrm:cd324a071ebecdda.question: Liệt kê nhân viên có lương từ 10 triệu đến 30 triệu
hrm:cd324a071ebecdda.sql:
SELECT d.department_id, d.department_name, COUNT(e.employee_id) as count
    FROM department d
    LEFT JOIN employee e ON d.department_id = e.department_id
    GROUP BY d.department_id, d.department_name
    ORDER BY count DESC
    LIMIT 100;

hrm:2a280e30278565dd.question: Nhân viên phòng IT vào làm trước năm 2024
hrm:2a280e30278565dd.sql:
SELECT
    e.employee_id,
    e.employee_name,
    d.department_name,
    e.job_title,
    e.employment_status,
    e.hire_date
FROM employee e
JOIN department d ON e.department_id = d.department_id

hrm:4711c7ce47bef733.question: Danh sách nhân viên nam đang thử việc ở phòng kỹ thuật
hrm:4711c7ce47bef733.sql:
SELECT
    e.employee_id,
    e.employee_name,
    d.department_name,
    e.job_title,
    e.employment_status,
    e.hire_date
FROM employee e
JOIN department d ON e.department_id = d.department_id
WHERE e.employment_status = 'PROBATION'
ORDER BY d.department_name, e.employee_name ASC
LIMIT 100;

hrm:fd714389845373a9.question: Nhân viên nào đang nghỉ phép hôm nay
hrm:fd714389845373a9.sql:
SELECT
    e.employee_id,
    e.employee_name,
    lr.start_date,
    lr.end_date,
    lr.status
FROM employee e
JOIN leave_request lr ON e.employee_id = lr.employee_id
WHERE lr.status = 'APPROVED'
  AND lr.start_date <= CURRENT_DATE
  AND lr.end_date >= CURRENT_DATE
ORDER BY lr.start_date DESC;

hrm:e7a9018e58996420.question: Tổng hợp ngày công và ngày nghỉ phép tháng 3 của nhân viên EMP003
hrm:e7a9018e58996420.sql:
SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN a.status = 'PRESENT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_work_days,
    SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'APPROVED' THEN l.total_days ELSE 0 END) AS total_leave_days
FROM employee e
LEFT JOIN attendance a ON e.employee_id = a.employee_id 
    AND a.attendance_date BETWEEN '2024-03-01' AND '2024-03-31'
LEFT JOIN leave_request l ON e.employee_id = l.employee_id 
    AND l.start_date <= '2024-03-31' 
    AND l.end_date >= '2024-03-01'
    AND l.status = 'APPROVED'
WHERE e.employee_id = 'EMP003'
GROUP BY e.employee_id;

hrm:cc21515a86adfa9d.question: Nhân viên EMP008 có mặt bao nhiêu ngày trong tháng 2 năm 2026
hrm:cc21515a86adfa9d.sql:
SELECT
    a.employee_id,
    e.employee_name,
    a.attendance_date,
    SUM(CASE WHEN a.status = 'PRESENT'  THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)        AS present_days,
    SUM(CASE WHEN a.status = 'LATE'     THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)        AS late_days,
    SUM(CASE WHEN a.status = 'REMOTE'   THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)        AS remote_days,
    SUM(CASE WHEN a.status = 'ABSENT'   THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)        AS absent_days,
    SUM(CASE WHEN a.status = 'ON_LEAVE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)        AS on_leave_days,
    COUNT(*)                                                       AS total_working_days
FROM attendance a
JOIN employee e ON a.employee_id = e.employee_id
WHERE a.employee_id = 'EMP008'
  AND a.attendance_date LIKE '2026-02%'
GROUP BY a.employee_id, e.employee_name, a.attendance_date
LIMIT 100;
